“Universo Immersivo” Yoshi+ Moshi (Chiasso TI, Switzerland)

The performance “Universo Immersivo” explores the tension between the informative overflow, the dissolution of time and the aesthetics of deceleration. The performers Yoshi + Moshi dive with us into their hyperreality, changing the course of things.

performances.title: PERFORMANCES
performances.lede: Bodies in motion. New formats. No two nights the same.
performances.panel: Yoshi + Moshi have come to stay. They can’t meet all your expectations, but they get better in the process. Most of the time, at least. Of course they have performance formats but usually they do something brand new. Anyway, a few snippets below.

films.title: FILMS
films.lede:
Short films, live moments and moving
images.
films.panel: Yoshi + Moshi keep moving. Sometimes on stage, sometimes on screen, and sometimes without much of a plan. Not every moment makes it into a film, but a few do. Anyway, press play and see what happens.

pictures.title: PICTURES
pictures.lede:
A few moments standing still. Yoshi + Moshi
rarely do.
pictures.panel: Yoshi + Moshi are not always easy to pin down. Sometimes a camera helps. On stage, on the road, or somewhere in between — a few moments stayed still long enough to end up here. Anyway, take a look.

about.lede: live and work in Mendrisio TI, Switzerland
about.panel: Yoshi + Moshi are not easy to sum up. They turn up in performances, films and exhibitions, usually with a few surprises. A biography helps, but only up to a point. Here are some selected projects and places.
